title: Class Action Fairness Act — original jurisdiction
must_contain: exceeds the sum or value of $5,000,000

title: FTC Act § 5 — unfair or deceptive acts or practices
must_contain: unfair or deceptive acts or practices in or affecting commerce, are hereby declared unlawful

title: HIPAA Security Rule — general requirements
must_contain: Ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all electronic protected health information

title: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule — notice to individuals
must_contain: without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach

title: California Consumer Privacy Act — private right of action for data breaches
must_contain: not less than one hundred dollars ($100) and not greater than seven hundred and fifty ($750) per consumer per incident

title: California — duty to maintain reasonable security procedures
must_contain: implement and maintain reasonable security procedures and practices

title: California Customer Records Act — breach notification
must_contain: shall be made within 30 calendar days of discovery or notification of the data breach

title: California Customer Records Act — civil remedies
must_contain: Any customer injured by a violation of this title may institute a civil action to recover damages

title: California Unfair Competition Law
must_contain: any unlawful, unfair or fraudulent business act or practice

title: Washington — breach notification by persons and businesses
must_contain: shall disclose any breach of the security of the system

title: Washington — breach notification violations enforceable under the Consumer Protection Act
must_contain: unfair or deceptive act in trade or commerce

title: Washington Consumer Protection Act — unfair practices unlawful
must_contain: unfair or deceptive acts or practices in the conduct of any trade or commerce are hereby declared unlawful

title: Washington Consumer Protection Act — private civil action, treble damages
must_contain: Any person who is injured in his or her business or property by a violation of RCW 19.86.020
